answer.reason: The wilderness of Maon is where David hid from Saul's pursuit, which is an event of the story beyond a list entry.

clauses.english: was where David and his men hid while Saul pursued them
clauses.quote: he pursued after David in the wilderness of Maon

doubts: JOS 15:55 is only a list of towns, so it was left out.
JDG 10:12 names the Maonites as a people who oppressed Israel; it may not refer to this place, so it was left out.
1SA 25:2 only says where Nabal lived, so it was left out.
